search_window.basis: Previous verified Food Line heartbeat completion, not search-index recency; screen source-published and event timestamps against this bounded window.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall, not the authoritative Food Line nationwide production collector.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting the only, sole, last or full-service grocery store in a community
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closed fire November 2026 community
"last grocery store" closing closed fire November 2026
food pantry distribution suspended flood fire power outage November 2026
food bank pantry emergency closure canceled today November 2 2026
coverage_notes.observation: No newly source-published, verifiable qualifying U.S. food-access interruption identified since the prior persisted check. Results largely covered September/October local incidents, 2025 SNAP shutdown reports, routine benefits program information and pre-existing Provo closure reporting. A November 2 revision to Washington ABAWD eligibility instructions did not establish an immediate interruption to food access.

excluded_examples.title: Provo Food Bank Closes After Raising $100,000 in Emergency Fund
excluded_examples.reason: Predates prior run's completion and concerns already monitored Provo food-bank closure/access loss; duplicate within this hourly watch.

excluded_examples.title: Town of Spencer recovering after losing only grocery store in fire
excluded_examples.reason: September incident; not newly published or changed within this watch window.

excluded_examples.title: El Paso food bank suffers severe flooding damage, closes for clean up efforts
excluded_examples.reason: Historical temporary storm disruption, outside time window.

excluded_examples.title: ABAWDs - Able-Bodied Adults Without Dependents
excluded_examples.reason: Policy/instructions revised Nov 2; no verified newly interrupted benefits, outage or immediate access loss.

excluded_examples.title: Arvada Loses Its Safeway and The Bluegrass This Fall
excluded_examples.reason: Preannounced upcoming closure; other grocery store across street and therefore not sole grocery access loss.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched prior ops/watch-ledger heartbeat, used persisted completion as cutoff, excluded duplicate Provo reports and prior disruptions.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted web-index searches do not establish exhaustive coverage of unindexed hyperlocal or provider notices. Search indexing and crawler freshness were not treated as incident publication timestamps.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, schedule/automation, or production collector changes.
